name: Beyond Meat
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's primarily pea protein-based without significant FODMAPs. Some individuals may be sensitive to pea protein itself.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels as formulations may vary between products
Cook thoroughly according to package directions
Pair with low-FODMAP seasonings like herbs and garlic-infused oil
Avoid Beyond products with onion or garlic powder if listed in ingredients
nutritionalHighlights: Lower in saturated fat than beef
